conditions: Rest energy of a body with positive invariant mass m, evaluated in its rest frame; c is the vacuum speed of light. E is not the general total energy of a moving massive body.
spoken_aliases: energy equals mass times the speed of light squared

evidence: For a massive body in its rest frame, total relativistic momentum is zero. The invariant energy-momentum equation gives E^2=m^2 c^4. Choosing positive rest energy gives E=mc^2. Equivalently the total energy gamma mc^2 has gamma=1 at rest; total energy in a moving frame is generally greater.
Reference checked 2026-11-27: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-3/pages/5-key-equations. Proposed maintainer approval, not independent human certification.
